note: Republic Bank's guide to its accounts in Anguilla (revised September 2023, published on its Anguilla site): the E-Free Account, its everyday account, has no monthly fee, with three free teller withdrawals a month and 15 dollars for each one after, which the game doesn't count. Its personal chequing account costs 13 dollars a month.
